what: Audit of every merged human PR still blocked by rgm_anticheat.py --profile review (v0.21.0; two entries added in v0.24.0).
method: Each blocking finding was read against the PR diff and PR title; for removals the assertion-like lines removed vs added across the whole diff are counted. Verdicts are a reviewer's judgment (made with an AI assistant), not ground truth; they are committed so anyone can disagree line by line.
